Tomorrow,  October 16th at 4:40pm EST on AM620 WZON, please join me and @ashleymeaster on the “Downtown with Rich Kimball” @DowntownRichK radio show as we talk about @Courage365 and @hiresurvivors!

#courage365 #hiresurvivors #hiresurvivorshollywood #hollywood #survivor #metoo https://t.co/FO1Pm9V8Ue

I'm unsurprised that NBC gave the dictator in chief a town hall. Don't forget that #NBC killed @RonanFarrow and @RichMcHugh's Weinstein story. As one of Weinstein's survivors, I haven't forgotten.
#catchandkill #complicitNBC #metoo #HireSurvivorsHollywood @hiresurvivors

I'll be on the radio today with @ashleymeaster at 4.40pm Eastern/1.40pm Pacific discussing @courage365 and @hiresurvivors w/ @DowntownRichK. Please tune in!
#metoo #BelieveSurvivors #HireSurvivorsHollywood

Can finally announce! @louisettegeiss wrote a musical based on several survivor's stories, mine included! And, I'm a member of the cast! I've been directed by one of my heroes, Susan Stroman! I've been singing @Diane_Warren's songs! Dreams come true! @hiresurvivors #metoo

Amazing news! @louisettegeiss is the real deal: talented, giving, and committed to the mission of @hiresurvivors! Also, I'm *in this cast* and get to work with @Diane_Warren, Susan Stroman, and a group of wildly talented Broadway performers! #metoo #hiresurvivorshollywood

What's that? My name listed in the cast with some of the most talented Broadway performers ever? Yeah. Sure. No big deal. ::faints:: (And yes, @diane_warren and Susan Stroman are as amazing and cool as you hope they will be). Gosh I love @louisettegeiss! #metoo @hiresurvivors

Yes! There is *actually* some good news about live theater & #Broadway today! So honored to be in this cast & to have shared my story for the development of the script! And would you look at the creative team? @louisettegeiss, @Diane_Warren, Susan Stromam! #metoo @hiresurvivors

Being in the same cast as so many amazing #Broadway performers will never get old! Some actual good news about live theater announced today! And yes, I get to sing @Diane_Warren songs and be directed by Susan Stroman! @louisettegeiss you are doing it!!! #metoo @hiresurvivors

.@thr coverage on the @louisettegeiss and Howard Kagan penned new #metoo musical! With songs by @Diane_Warren! Directed and choreographed by Susan Stroman! And I am in the cast! And almost 2 dozen survivors (myself included) shared out stories for the development! @hiresurvivors
